# Ascon-AEAD128 reference implementation

These files are the `crypto_aead/asconaead128/ref` implementation from the
official [ascon/ascon-c](https://github.com/ascon/ascon-c) repository at commit
`446347f21b209f3921c65ece70027c366cbe1693` (2026-01-28), plus its eBACS API
header and repository `LICENSE`.

The upstream project dedicates the implementation to the public domain under
CC0 1.0. Fuse Vault keeps it isolated here so its origin and future updates can
be reviewed independently.
